high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for a US tour in 2025 by the artist Sofia Isella, with support from Ayleen Valentine. The poster has a monochromatic, gritty aesthetic with a distressed background that gives it an edgy feel. At the top of the poster, the text reads "US TOUR 2025" in a bold, sans-serif font. Below this, the phrase "YOU'LL UNDERSTAND MORE, DICK." is prominently displayed in large, bold letters, suggesting a provocative or humorous tone. The text is followed by the name "SOFIA ISELLA"
